text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I visit the hot spring with Mayano Top
Gun one
day after completing numerous
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter... Rattle!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya comes in for the landing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heya, Trainer! I'm here, right in your
room!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't be like some boring teacher!
You're
supposed to say "Hi, Maya" with
a look of love in
your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting and waiting for this trip
to the
hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're using the hot spring vacation
coupon we
won at the shopping district
for this trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Mayano Top Gun has
accomplished her
goals, this is our
chance to take a break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're both going to alleviate our
exhaustion by
kicking back and relaxing
a little.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But how come we're in separate rooms?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you gonna get lonely? Do you
really want
to be by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmgrgh... But like...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you're by yourself, who are you gonna
have
pillow fights and play cards with?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I can do those things with you! If you're
with me,
you'll have a hundred times
more fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell from her face just how much
she wants
to goof off with me...
choice_data_list: ...Shall we play for just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! See? Even you think it's so much
more fun
with me around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not often that we get to relax like
this, so
Mayano Top Gun and I spend
some time
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I realize it, the entire day has
passed. We
should get moving if we
actually want to use the
hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't bring myself to wake her up, so I
leave her
sleeping in my room and go to
the hot spring
alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Don't leave me behind like that,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sob... I wanna take a bath too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay...
choice_data_list: I'll wait until you're done for the day.
I'll wait until you're done for the day.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Here? You're gonna stay here
the whole
time?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying I can see you the second
I'm
finished?
choice_data_list: You'll be able to see them.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Don't you go anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! It's like you're my dad.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! It's like you're my mom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! That felt so good! I feel nice and
warm all
over!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're wide awake now, huh.
Looks like you're wide awake now, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I've got a thousand times more
energy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, they're selling ice cream over there!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And it's triple scoop! Not single, not
double, but
triple! I want vanilla,
strawberry, and chocolate!
choice_data_list: Maybe you've got a little too much energy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha. Hurry up! I'm about to take off. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mayano Top Gun runs off to
the ice
cream vendor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although we came to the hot spring to
relax, sure
enough, I'm being dragged
around once more...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What flavor would you like? We could
go halfsies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Mayano Top Gun and I have
formed
an irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
